answer: Admission auction blocks bulk fake identities. Each epoch auctions fixed slots: applicants bid, top bidders win, losers are refunded. An atlas lists slot, winner, price, so no farm can quietly seize hundreds of seats. Forging 1,000 identities at 50 credits each costs 50,000; one honest agent pays 50 for an undiluted reward share, and that price delta makes farming unprofitable. Cheaters forfeit bids; an ivory mark flags verified participants.
